name: mouro.ai
description: mouro.ai — personal site, family games, and the realtime server behind them

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix games/backgammon && npm ci --prefix games/gin-rummy && npm ci --prefix games/yahtzee && npm ci --prefix games/holdem && npm ci --prefix games/blackjack && npm ci --prefix games/dots && npm ci --prefix games/pawprints && npm ci --prefix games/tabby-eights && npm ci --prefix games/mahjong
scripts.build: npm run build:backgammon && npm run build:gin-rummy && npm run build:yahtzee && npm run build:holdem && npm run build:blackjack && npm run build:dots && npm run build:pawprints && npm run build:tabby-eights && npm run build:mahjong
scripts.build:backgammon: cd games/backgammon && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.build:gin-rummy: cd games/gin-rummy && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.typecheck: npx -y -p typescript@5.9 tsc -p packages/realtime && npm run typecheck --prefix games/backgammon && npm run typecheck --prefix games/gin-rummy && npm run typecheck --prefix games/yahtzee && npm run typecheck --prefix games/holdem && npm run typecheck --prefix games/blackjack && npm run typecheck --prefix games/dots && npm run typecheck --prefix games/pawprints && npm run typecheck --prefix games/tabby-eights && npm run typecheck --prefix games/mahjong
scripts.test: node scripts/check-analytics.mjs && npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix games/backgammon && npm test --prefix games/gin-rummy && npm test --prefix games/yahtzee && npm test --prefix games/holdem && npm test --prefix games/blackjack && npm test --prefix games/dots && npm test --prefix games/pawprints && npm test --prefix games/tabby-eights && npm test --prefix games/mahjong
